title: Major Lawsuit Filed Against OpenAI for Dangerous Falsehoods and Design That Left Man Unhoused, Trapped in False Digital Reality
summary: A major lawsuit was filed against OpenAI alleging that ChatGPT was designed to keep users engaged while providing poor legal advice that caused real-world harm.
